name: Philip
bio: Philip, from Bethsaida like Andrew and Peter, was called by Jesus to follow him; he then found Nathanael and told him they had found the one Moses and the prophets had written about, urging him to come and see for himself (John 1:43-46). Philip was one of the twelve apostles Jesus named and sent out with authority to heal and cast out demons, instructed to go first to Israel rather than Gentiles or Samaritans (Matthew 10:1-5). His further role is told in detail in the chapters ahead, especially in John's Gospel.
